activity: Alerts check (cost; errors and timeouts; safety flags not cleared)
output: Nothing, or an incident or a fix ticket
acts_on: Cost over twice the 4-week daily average; errors over 5% of calls; a safety flag not handled the same day

activity: Spot audit: 20 random sent drafted replies per language plus every flagged money draft
output: Wrong-reply rate per channel and language
acts_on: Above today's rate two weeks running: that channel and language off (stop rule 2)

inputs: Weekly reports, eval re-run, value numbers, incidents, change log, vendor notices
output: Decisions: continue, adjust, restrict, roll back, suspend, retire
